resolved_conflicts.explanation: The report gives August 1951 as the build month. Canada Lookouts files the entry under 1952, which is the year of the report, so the story gives 1951 as the build year.

notes_for_editor: One source for the tower: Canada Lookouts quotes the 116th annual report of the Department of Lands and Mines, which it files under 1952; the report gives the build month as August 1951. The report calls the tower Clark Tower, and Canada Lookouts headlines the entry Clark Mountain, which is the brief's name. The brief's coordinates (47.0916, -66.9136) were not checked against a source. A Wikipedia page for Trousers Lake was not found (404). Two WebSearch calls turned up no records for a Fraser or Restigouche tower, and nothing on the tower's staffing, later use, removal or present condition. The brief had no build event, so this is an addition, not a correction. Confidence is low: one quoted report, a company-owned tower, and no source on the site today.
